nodes.label: ShellSmash BambooSmash Mini-Game Concept Art
nodes.description: Concept art for the Bamboo Bash mini-game inside Shell Smash. Shows a 4-player top-down arena with bamboo obstacles. Player slots: KameMaster (1P), TurtleNinja (2P), OshiShell (3P), SakuraKame (4P). UI includes countdown timer, per-player score, action-based scoring (Bambu Pequeño +10, Mediano +25, Grande +50, Especial +75, Moneda +5, Potenciador +25, Impacto Rival +20), four arena variants (Bosque de Bambú, Aldea del Río, Templo Oculto, Jardín Zen), game modes (Duelo, Todos contra Todos, Por Equipos, Desafío Diario), power-ups (Empuje, Escudo, Turbo, Imán), global leaderboard, and a rewards panel showing coins/trophies/collectibles.
